Sources/SilliesAudio/AudioCaptureInputQu: Retained CMSampleBuffer crosses the capture queue after its producer relinquishes mutation; packet fields are immutable. Queue bounds cover its retained bytes.
Sources/SilliesApp/Platform/Accessibilit: AX elements and observers belong to its worker thread/run loop; request lock protects cross-thread scheduling. AX reads assert worker execution and shutdown stops observation.
Sources/SilliesApp/Platform/WindowMetada: Synchronous socket connection is owned by WindowMetadataClient under its lock, never the main actor. Reads and construction assert off-main execution; close releases descriptors/process.
Sources/SilliesAudio/ApplicationAudioSou: SCStream is an SDK handle without Sendable conformance. Its slot and stopped flag are Mutex-protected; successful startup publishes once, stop removes the handle before awaiting shutdown, and cancelled startup stops its unpublished stream.
Private non-Sendable state can only be accessed through withValue on the supplied serial queue, enforced by dispatchPrecondition. Access never dispatches synchronously; results must be Sendable. State is created exclusively for this owner, must not escape callbacks, and reentrant calls use reference state rather than overlapping inout access.
Sources/SilliesSpeechApple/AnalyzerSpeec: AVAudioConverter and the chunker are used only inside the input Mutex. Neither escapes; failure callbacks run after unlocking. AVAudioConverter can retain SDK input buffers that lack Sendable annotations.
Sources/SilliesSpeech/WindowSpeechChanne: AVAudioConverter and the PCM window are accessed exclusively under the input Mutex. Conversion occurs on the capture worker; immutable sample snapshots cross to inference. Callbacks run after unlocking and cancellation releases buffers.
Sources/SilliesSpeech/StreamingDiarizati: AVAudioConverter is used only under the input Mutex on the capture worker. PCM is copied into a duration-bounded array; inference receives immutable samples. Failure and completion callbacks run after unlocking; cancellation clears staged audio.
Sources/SilliesInference/InferenceCancel: NSLock owns cancellation state. Actions execute outside the lock; the installed task has a bounded lifetime.
Sources/SilliesTextModels/TextWorkerConn: One actor serializes pipe I/O on a detached worker. NSLock owns process stop state; cancellation only kills the owned child. WorkerExitSignal awaits termination asynchronously before speech resumes.
Sources/SilliesTextModels/WorkerExitSign: NSLock owns completion state and waiter continuations. Completions resume outside the lock; the Process termination handler owns the signal until exit.
